# MeticleCare

> Care operations software for domiciliary and supported living providers across the UK.

MeticleCare (https://meticlecare.com) is one connected platform for UK care operations:
rostering and visits, care records, medication (eMAR), compliance and CQC readiness,
workforce, family portal, reporting, and a mobile app for carers.

## Key pages

- [Platform](https://meticlecare.com/platform): what the platform covers end to end
- [Solutions](https://meticlecare.com/solutions/domiciliary-care): domiciliary care
- [Solutions](https://meticlecare.com/solutions/supported-living): supported living
